frequency_question: How often do major comprehensive permitting reform bills successfully pass both chambers and get signed into law within a given 24-month congressional session?
membership_rule: Includes any major bipartisan or party-led omnibus energy, transmission, or permitting reform legislation explicitly targeting interstate infrastructure/pipelines that received serious floor consideration or committee markup. Excludes minor provisions bundled into routine appropriations or authorization bills without dedicated permitting reform focus.

coverage_note: 8 named congressional sessions; covers the modern era of polarized energy legislation from 2005 to 2024.
known_gaps: Excludes minor tweaks embedded in omnibus defense or disaster relief bills.
validity_reason: Legislative gridlock dynamics and polarization metrics remain relatively stable across multi-year cycles.
